description: Source code, a responsive PCB review-workstation interface, and metadata-only evidence for a board-aware PCB defect-detection study of same-board exposure, a pre-registered six-board leave-one-board-out replication, reproducible evaluation contracts, and calibration-only deployment validation.
notes: No dataset pixels, model weights, ONNX exports, or TensorRT engines are included. The upstream dataset license remains unverified; model and export redistribution rights are not asserted. Performance evidence is calibration-only where stated and is not a production SLA. Aggregate L4 fidelity passed, while strict per-box parity failed for both exported backends under frozen thresholds on the first L4 run; after a reference input-geometry fix in the runner, the unchanged gate still failed by one TensorRT FP16 box while ONNX Runtime CUDA matched PyTorch on 60/60 calibration images.
title: PCB Defect Detection: Leakage-Aware Evaluation and Deployment Evidence
